segments.prompt:
3:4 vertical, 11 seconds, minimalist studio product film for a quiet luxury handbag brand, one continuous take, smooth slow handheld drift, bright soft even studio light, calm and unhurried pacing.

@Image1 is the Velantra Meridian handbag in black and @Image2 shows the same bag up close with its silver hardware and open top. The bag in every frame matches @Image1 exactly, a structured black pebbled leather look tote, two rolled top handles, a thin belt strap running across the front with a small brushed silver rectangular lock plate in the center and two silver keeper tips, clean minimal silhouette with flared side wings, no logos anywhere on the bag, dark charcoal fabric interior.

Scene: a young woman with fair skin wearing a boxy white t shirt and a flowing black midi skirt stands behind a waist high grey concrete plinth in front of a plain warm white studio wall. Her head and face stay above the top edge of the frame for the entire video, only her torso, arms and hands are ever visible. The room is empty, bare wall and bare plinth, no props, no furniture, nothing else in frame.

[0:00 to 0:02] Camera: tight close up, the bag fills most of the frame in front of her torso, she holds it out toward the camera by both top handles and it hangs and sways gently. Her hands: both wrapped around the handles. Light: soft even studio light from the front left. Background: plain warm white wall, softly out of focus.

[0:02 to 0:04] Camera: drifts slightly right as she lowers the bag onto the concrete plinth in side profile, the two rolled handles arc upward, the front belt strap and silver lock plate catch the light. Her hands steady the bag from behind.

[0:04 to 0:06] Camera: holds close while both her hands pull the top of the bag open wide toward the camera, revealing the dark charcoal fabric interior and one inner slip pocket, the leather look surface flexes softly with a matte sheen.

[0:06 to 0:08] Camera: she tilts the open bag toward the lens for one beat so the interior stays visible, then lets the top relax closed and grips both handles, standing the bag upright on the plinth.

[0:08 to 0:11] Camera: she lifts the bag onto her shoulder and turns a few degrees, the bag hangs at her hip in a clean side silhouette close to the lens, then holds nearly still for the final two seconds.

On screen text: a persistent caption in small clean white sans serif type sits at the bottom center of the frame for the entire 11 seconds and reads exactly: A closer look at the Meridian. From 0:08 until the end an additional wordmark in thin elegant white serif capital letters appears centered over the bag and reads exactly: VELANTRA. All text is crisp, level, small and understated. No other text, numbers or watermarks anywhere in the frame.

Audio: quiet studio room tone only, soft leather and fabric handling sounds, no voice, no music.
